THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of below mentioned lands depicted in the Advanced Tracing No. GA/WAT/2020/290 dated 26.06.2023, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Elapitiwala in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 179-Elapitiwala in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Wattala in Gampaha District of Western Province and bounded as follows:
1. Lot ‘A1’ – Extent: 0.2685 Hectare
North: Lot A2 and the Stream; East: Lot B1 in the
Preliminary Plan No. GM/DSO/2023/460, the marshland
(name not known) - owner unidentified, Lot B2 of this
Preliminary Plan and the marshland (name not known) -
owner unidentiﬁ ed; South: Marshland (name not known) -
owner unidentiﬁ ed, Lots B4 and B3 in the Preliminary Plan
No. GM/DSO/2023/460; West: Lot A2.
2. Lot ‘A2’ – Extent: 2.9242 Hectares
North: Owner unidentiﬁ ed marshland and the Stream;
East: Lot A1, Lots B4, B3 and B4 in the Preliminary Plan
No. GM/DSO/2023/460; South: Lot A1, Lots B4, B3 and B4
in the Preliminary Plan No. GM/DSO/2023/460 and Lot A3
of this Preliminary Plan; West: Lot A3.
